_source: registry.d/apt-to-flatpak.json — apt -> Flathub conversion, staged for merge into registry.json | REVISED 2026-08-17 for roadmap/INSTALL-METHODOLOGY.md: blender converts to Flathub after all (amd64 only — arm64 is LOST, see its _note) and wine is PARKED with _disabled, because with apt gone neither can stay where it was.
_signing: UNSIGNED BY CONSTRUCTION. Every entry below carries "signature": "". Nothing verifies registry.d fragments; registry.json is the only signed app artifact. After merging these entries, run `make sign-registry` (re-signs ALL entries in sorted-id order) and then `make verify-registry-prod`. Any byte changed after signing invalidates that entry.
_verified_by: scripts/verify-flatpak-candidates.sh (Flathub API + real `flatpak remote-info` in a debian:trixie container). Resolvability and architecture are measured. Launch/render behaviour is NOT proven here — that is scripts/verify-app-recipe.sh's job.
_excluded: steam — removed per APP-CATALOG policy 1a (proprietary apps out of scope, reversible). Findings retained in roadmap/FLATPAK-MIGRATION.md.

ardour.name: Ardour
ardour.description: Professional digital audio workstation — multi-track recording, editing, mixing, and mastering
ardour.author: Paul Davis and The Ardour Community
ardour._note: apt -> Flathub. org.ardour.Ardour publishes aarch64 AND x86_64, so arch WIDENS from ["amd64"] to both — arm64 boxes gain Ardour. Flathub publisher NOT verified (upstream Ardour sells official builds; the Flathub package is community-maintained). Flatpak command is ardour9; the old apt recipe ran ardour8.

blender.author: Blender Foundation
blender.description: 3D creation suite — modelling, animation, rendering, compositing, and video editing
blender.name: Blender
blender._note: REVISED 2026-08-17, and this is a LOSS that must not be quiet. The earlier decision — 'stays on apt, because org.blender.Blender is x86_64-only on Flathub (measured: `flatpak remote-info flathub --arch=aarch64` -> Can't find ref) while Debian trixie ships blender 4.3.2 for amd64 AND arm64' — was correct while apt was still an install vehicle. It is not any more (roadmap/INSTALL-METHODOLOGY.md), so the choice is no longer Flathub-versus-Debian, it is Flathub-versus-NOTHING. blender.org publishes no official Linux aarch64 build either, so no `artifacts` entry can recover arm64 coverage; there is nothing to pin. ARM64 BOXES LOSE BLENDER, and they will see the honest 'requires amd64; this box is arm64' rather than an install that fails. This is the single largest capability loss in the migration and it is the founder's to reverse — reversing it means keeping an unpinned apt path for one app.

darktable.name: Darktable
darktable._note: apt -> Flathub. Publishes aarch64 AND x86_64, so arch WIDENS from ["amd64"]. Publisher NOT verified. Flathub manifest grants --device=all (superset of dri), so the needs_gpu lane is satisfied inside the sandbox.

gnucash.author: GnuCash Development Team
gnucash._note: apt -> Flathub. Publishes aarch64 AND x86_64; arch WIDENS from ["amd64"]. Publisher VERIFIED by Flathub via gnucash.org.

libreoffice.name: LibreOffice
libreoffice.description: Full office suite — word processor, spreadsheets, presentations, and database with MS Office compatibility
libreoffice.author: The Document Foundation
libreoffice._note: apt -> Flathub. Publishes aarch64 AND x86_64; arch made explicit (was null). Publisher VERIFIED via libreoffice.org. Version key changed "26.2" -> "latest": a Flatpak tracks Flathub's stable branch, so pinning a version number in the key would assert a version Vulos does not control.

lmms.name: LMMS
lmms.description: Linux MultiMedia Studio — beat+bassline editor, song editor, synthesizers, and VST plugin support
lmms.author: LMMS Developers
lmms._note: apt -> Flathub. Correct id is io.lmms.LMMS (capitals). APP-CATALOG.md lists io.lmms.lmms, which is a 404 — flatpak ids are case-sensitive. Publishes aarch64 AND x86_64; arch WIDENS from ["amd64"]. Publisher NOT verified. Flathub manifest shares ipc only, NOT network — the recipe never claimed network, so no regression.

lutris.author: Lutris Project
lutris.description: Open-source gaming platform — manage and launch games from GOG, Epic, emulators, and Windows installers
lutris.name: Lutris
lutris._note: apt -> Flathub. DEFECT FIX: entry arch was null (= all arches), so arm64 boxes were offered Lutris and the install could not work; net.lutris.Lutris is x86_64-only, and entry-level arch is the only arch field the installer enforces. The per-recipe "arch": "amd64" that used to sit inside this version is DEAD DATA — VersionRecipe has no Arch field, it lands in Extra and is never read. Dropped env VULOS_GAMING=1: no code in the tree reads it, and a bare `flatpak run` would not carry it into the sandbox anyway. Description no longer claims Steam (Steam is out of catalogue scope). Publisher VERIFIED via lutris.net.

obs-studio.author: OBS Project
obs-studio.description: Open Broadcaster Software — screen recording and live streaming with scenes, sources, and filters
obs-studio.name: OBS Studio
obs-studio._note: apt -> Flathub. com.obsproject.Studio is x86_64-only, which MATCHES the arch ["amd64"] this entry already declared — so unlike Blender, this conversion loses nothing. Publisher VERIFIED via obsproject.com. Flathub manifest grants --device=all and xdg-run/pipewire-0, which is what screen capture needs.

octave.name: GNU Octave
octave.description: High-level language for numerical computations — MATLAB-compatible syntax, plotting, and signal processing
octave.author: GNU Project
octave._note: apt -> Flathub. Publishes aarch64 AND x86_64; arch WIDENS from ["amd64"]. Publisher VERIFIED via octave.org. NOTE: this app's runtime is org.kde.Sdk/6.10, an SDK rather than a Platform — roughly a gigabyte more on disk than a Platform-based app. Deliberate upstream choice (Octave builds mex files at runtime), not a packaging error.

qgis.name: QGIS
qgis.description: Free and open-source GIS — view, edit, and analyse geospatial data with layers, plugins, and map export
qgis.author: QGIS Development Team
qgis._note: apt -> Flathub. flatpak_id MUST stay branch-qualified as org.qgis.qgis//stable. QGIS publishes TWO branches (stable and lts) and FlatpakInstall runs `flatpak install -y --noninteractive flathub <id>` with no branch, which for a bare id exits 1: "Multiple branches available for org.qgis.qgis, you must specify one of: .../stable, .../lts". Verified that the //stable suffix resolves cleanly through that same argv. Flathub's API reports a single "branch":"stable" for this app, so metadata alone does NOT catch this. Publishes aarch64 AND x86_64; arch WIDENS from ["amd64"]. Publisher VERIFIED via qgis.org.

shotcut.author: Meltytech, LLC
shotcut.description: Free, open-source video editor — multi-track timeline, 4K support, hundreds of filters and transitions
shotcut.name: Shotcut
shotcut._note: apt -> Flathub. Publishes aarch64 AND x86_64; arch WIDENS from ["amd64"]. Publisher VERIFIED via shotcut.org. Flathub manifest grants --device=all, satisfying the needs_gpu lane inside the sandbox.

wine.author: WineHQ Project
wine.description: Windows compatibility layer — run Windows applications and games on Linux without a virtual machine
wine.name: Wine
wine._note: PARKED, NOT MIGRATED, 2026-08-17. wine has no expressible vehicle left and inventing one would be worse than saying so. (1) apt is gone. (2) WineHQ publishes .deb packages and no portable per-architecture tarball, so there is no artefact to pin — an `artifacts` entry here would require a URL that does not exist. (3) org.winehq.Wine on Flathub publishes SEVEN branches (stable-21.08 … stable-25.08, wow64-24.08, wow64-25.08) and NONE is named plain `stable`, so the bare id fails under FlatpakInstall; the `//branch` suffix does resolve (proved on QGIS) but every candidate is a dated branch that ages out, and WHICH one currently resolves is a `flatpak remote-info` measurement THAT WAS NOT RUN HERE. Guessing it is exactly the fabricated-value failure this work exists to remove. Disabled rather than deleted so the measured metadata survives for whoever runs that command. arch corrected to [amd64] regardless — that defect was independent of the vehicle.
